Summary: This bill would require all delivery services to verify that the mopeds used by their contracted delivery workers are in compliance with applicable law, rules and regulations.
Text:
A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring delivery services to verify the use of compliant mopeds by contracted delivery workers

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:


Section 1. Section 20-1501 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding new definitions of “compliant moped,” “delivery device” and “moped” in alphabetical order to read as follows:
Compliant moped. The term “compliant moped” means a moped that is in compliance with applicable law, rules, and regulations, including, but not limited to section 2261 of the vehicle and traffic law.
Delivery device. The term “delivery device” means a powered mobility device, or any other device or vehicle that is incapable of being registered with the department of motor vehicles.
Moped. The term “moped” means any limited use motorcycle as defined in section 121-b of the vehicle and traffic law. 
§ 2. Subchapter 2 of chapter 15 of title 20 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding two new sections 20-1528 and 20-1528.1 to read as follows:
§ 20-1528 Notice of compliant moped verification. The department shall, in consultation with the department of transportation, create a notice that summarizes the rights and responsibilities of a contracted delivery worker pursuant to section 20-1528.1. The department shall post such notice on the department’s website. A delivery service shall provide such notice to each contracted delivery worker retained by such service to deliver goods on behalf of such service by email, and as a link sent by text message, no later than the effective date of the local law that added this section, provided that such a delivery service shall provide such notice to a contracted delivery worker retained by such service for the first time after such effective date no later than 7 days after the date such service retains such worker. A delivery service shall provide such notice to a contracted delivery worker in English and the preferred language of such contracted delivery worker, provided that the department has posted such notice in such language, and further provided that such contracted delivery worker has communicated the preferred language of such worker to such delivery service.
§ 20-1528.1 Compliant moped verification. a. A delivery service shall determine whether each contracted delivery worker who delivers goods on behalf of such delivery service uses a moped to make such deliveries. 
b. A delivery service shall request a contracted delivery worker who uses a moped to deliver goods on behalf of such delivery service submit documentation demonstrating that such worker owns, rents, or has access to a compliant moped, provided that such a worker shall have no less than 60 days to respond to such a request to submit such documentation, or to submit proof that such worker owns, rents, or has access to a compliant delivery device other than a compliant moped. Such verification may include, but need not be limited to, a copy of a certificate of registration required by section 2261 of the vehicle and traffic law for such complaint moped. The department may require that a delivery service provide proof of such verification to the department in a format prescribed by rule of the department. 
c. Notwithstanding any provision of this code to the contrary, where such a contracted delivery worker fails to submit any such documentation to such delivery service within 60 days, such a delivery service may restrict the authorization of such worker to accept trips on the delivery platform of such delivery service until such worker provides such documentation, provided that such delivery service shall provide such worker written notice, in a form prescribed by rule of the department, of such restriction, and provided further that such service shall reinstate or restore such authorization within 5 days of such worker submitting such documentation to such service.
d. The department shall conduct outreach and education about the requirements of this section to delivery services and contracted delivery workers.
§ 3. Subdivisions e and f of section 20-563.9 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as amended by local law number 133 for the year 2025, are amended, and a new subdivision g is added to such section, to read as follows:
e. Committed three or more violations of paragraph 1 of subdivision c of section 10-157; subdivision d of section 10-157; paragraph 1 of subdivision e of section 10-157; paragraph 3 of subdivision e of section 10-157; subdivision f of section 10-157; or paragraph 1 of subdivision i of section 10-157, within a [2 year] 2-year period, provided that violation of any rule promulgated pursuant to each such provision constitutes a violation of such provision; [or]
f. Committed six or more violations of any provision of paragraph 1 of subdivision c of section 10-157; subdivision d of section 10-157; paragraph 1 of subdivision e of section 10-157; paragraph 3 of subdivision e of section 10-157; subdivision f of section 10-157; or paragraph 1 of subdivision i of section 10-157, or of any rule promulgated by the department of transportation pursuant to each such provision within a [2 year] 2-year period; or
g. Committed six or more violations of any provision of section 20-1528 or section 20-1528.1, or of any rule promulgated by the department pursuant to such section, within a 2-year period.
§ 4. This local law takes effect 180 days after it becomes law, except that section 20-1528.1 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by section 2 of this local law, takes effect 1 year after it becomes law, provided that the department of consumer and worker protection shall conduct outreach and education about the requirements of such section 20-1528.1 to delivery services and contracted delivery workers no later than 60 days before such section 20-1528.1 takes effect.
